questions.question: $\mathrm{P}=\left[\begin{array}{rr}3 & 3 \\ -3 & -3\end{array}\right]$ হলে দেখাও যে, P একটি শূন্যঘাতি ম্যাট্রিক্স ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$P=\left[\begin{array}{rr}3 & 3 \\ -3 & -3\end{array}\right]$


এখন,


$\begin{aligned} \therefore P^2 & =P \cdot P=\left[\begin{array}{rr}3 & 3 \\ -3 & -3\end{array}\right] \cdot\left[\begin{array}{rr}3 & 3 \\ -3 & -3\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rr}9-9 & 9-9 \\ -9+9-9+9\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{ll}0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0\end{array}\right] \\ & =0\end{aligned}$


সুতরাং, P হলো শূণ্যঘাতি ম্যাট্রিক্স ।

questions.question: $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{A})$ নির্ণয় কর
questions.answer:
এখানে, $ f(x)=x^{2}-x+3$


বা, $f(A)=A^{2}-A+3 I$


$\mathrm{A}^{2}=\mathrm{A} \cdot \mathrm{A}$


$\begin{aligned}& =\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 4 \\2 & 2 & 3 \\4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 4 \\2 & 2 & 3 \\4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right] \\& =\left[\begin{array}{lll}1+4+16 & 1+4+16 & 1+4+16 \\1+4+16 & 1+4+16 & 1+4+16 \\1+4+16 & 1+4+16 & 1+4+16\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}$


$\begin{aligned} & f(A)=A^2-A+3 I \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}21 & 18 & -10 \\ 18 & 17 & -1 \\ -10 & -1 & 50\end{array}\right]-\left[\begin{array}{rrr}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right]+3\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}21 & 18 & -10 \\ 18 & 17 & -1 \\ -10 & -1 & 50\end{array}\right]-\left[\begin{array}{rrr}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right]+\left[\begin{array}{lll}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}23 & 16 & -14 \\ 16 & 18 & -4 \\ -14 & -4 & 58\end{array}\right] \text { [Ans. }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: প্রমান কর যে , $\mathrm{A}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{I}_{3}$
questions.answer:
$A=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right|$


$\begin{aligned} & |A|=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 4 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right| \\ & =1(-10-9)-2(-10-12)+4(6-8) \\ & =-19+44-8=17 \neq 0\end{aligned}$


A এর সহগুনক গুলো বের করে পাই ,


$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{A}_{11}=(-1)^{1+1}\left|\begin{array}{cc}2 & 3 \\ 3 & -5\end{array}\right|=-10-9=-19 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{12}=(-1)^{1+2}\left|\begin{array}{cc}2 & 3 \\ 4 & -5\end{array}\right|=-(-10-12)=22 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{13}=(-1)^{1+3}\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{array}\right|=6-8=-2 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{21}=(-1)^{2+1}\left|\begin{array}{cc}2 & 4 \\ 3 & -5\end{array}\right|=-(-10-12)=22 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{22}=(-1)^{2+2}\left|\begin{array}{cc}1 & 4 \\ 4 & -5\end{array}\right|=-5-16=-21 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{23}=(-1)^{2+3}\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\ 4 & 3\end{array}\right|=-(3-8)=5 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{31}=(-1)^{3+1}\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{array}\right|=6-8=-2 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{32}=(-1)^{3+2}\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 4 \\ 2 & 3\end{array}\right|=-(3-8)=5 \\ & \mathrm{~A}_{33}=(-1)^{3+3}\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\ 2 & 2\end{array}\right|=2-4=-2\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & \text { অতএব, adj } \mathrm{A}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-19 & 22 & -2 \\ 22 & -21 & 5 \\ -2 & 5 & -2\end{array}\right]^{\mathrm{T}}= {\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-19 & 22 & -2 \\ 22 & -21 & 5 \\ -2 & 5 & -2\end{array}\right]}\end{aligned}$


এখন, $\mathrm{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{|\mathrm{~A}|}$ adj $\mathrm{A}$


$=\frac{1}{17}\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-19 & 22 & -2 \\ 22 & -21 & 5 \\ -2 & 5 & -2\end{array}\right]$


$=\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{19}{17} & \frac{22}{17} & -\frac{2}{17}\\ \frac{22}{17} & -\frac{21}{17} & \frac{5}{17}\\-\frac{2}{17} & \frac{5}{17} & -\frac{2}{17}\end{bmatrix}$


আবার , $A^{-1},A=\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{19}{17} & \frac{22}{17} & -\frac{2}{17}\\ \frac{22}{17} & -\frac{21}{17} & \frac{5}{17}\\-\frac{2}{17} & \frac{5}{17} & -\frac{2}{17}\end{bmatrix}$


$\left\lceil\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 4 \\2 & 2 & 3 \\4 & 3 & -5\end{array}\right\rceil$


$=\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 0 & 0 \\0 & 1 & 0 \\0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right]=I_3$


$\mathrm{A}^{-1} \cdot \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{I}_3$

questions.question: $\left(\begin{array}{cc}-a & 6 \\ 2 & -a+1\end{array}\right)$ ম্যাট্রিক্সটি ব্যাতিক্রমী হুলে a এর মান বের কর।
questions.answer:
$\left|\begin{array}{cc}-a & 6 \\ 2 & -a+1\end{array}\right|=0$


বা, $a^{2}-a-12=0$


বা, $a^{2}-4 a+3 a-12=0$


বা, $a(a-4)+3(a-4)=0$


বা, $(a-4)(a+3)=0$


হয় , $a-4=0$ অথবা, $a+3=0$


বা, $a=4 \quad$ বা, $a=-3$


অর্থাৎ, $a=4,-3$ [Ans.]

questions.question: প্রমান কর যে , $|\mathrm{A}|=\mathrm{pqr}(\mathrm{p}-\mathrm{q})$
questions.answer:
L.H.S. $=|A|=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}p & q & r \\ p^{2} & q^{2} & r^{2} \\ p^{3} & q^{3} & r^{3}\end{array}\right]$


$=\operatorname{pqr}\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 1 & 1 \\ p & q & r \\ p^{2} & q^{2} & r^{2}\end{array}\right|$


$=p q r\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 0 & 0 \\ \mathrm{p} & \mathrm{q}-\mathrm{p} & \mathrm{r}-\mathrm{p} \\ \mathrm{p}^{2} & \mathrm{q}^{2}-\mathrm{p}^{2} & \mathrm{r}^{2}-\mathrm{p}^{2}\end{array}\right| \quad\left[\begin{array}{l}\mathrm{c}_{2}{ }^{\prime}=\mathrm{c}_{2}-\mathrm{c}_{1} \\ \mathrm{c}_{3}{ }^{\prime}=\mathrm{c}_{3}-\mathrm{c}_{1}\end{array}\right]$


$=p q r\left|\begin{array}{cc}q-p & r-p \\ q^{2}-p^{2} & r^{2}-p^{2}\end{array}\right|$


$=\operatorname{pqr}(q-p)(r-p)\left|\begin{array}{cr}1 & 1 \\ q+p & r+p\end{array}\right|$


$=-\operatorname{pqr}(p-q)(r-p)(r+p-q-p)$


$=-\operatorname{pqr}(p-q)(r-p)(r-q)$


$=\operatorname{pqr}(\mathrm{p}-\mathrm{q})(\mathrm{q}-\mathrm{r})(\mathrm{r}-\mathrm{p})=$ R.H.S [Proved]

questions.question: ক্রেমারের সূত্র ব্যবহার করে BX = C সমীকরণ জোটটি সমাধান কর ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\quad \mathrm{BX}=\mathrm{C}$


বা, $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}2 & 2 & -1 \\ 4 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4 & 2\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{l}x \\ y \\ z\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{l}5 \\ 1 \\ 6\end{array}\right]$


বা, $\left[\begin{array}{c}2 x+2 y-z \\ 4 x+2 y-3 z \\ x+4 y+2 z\end{array}\right]=\left[\begin{array}{c}5 \\ 1 \\ 6\end{array}\right]$


$\therefore 2 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}-\mathrm{z}=5$


$4 \mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{y}-3 \mathrm{z}=1$


$x+4 y+2 z=6$


$\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y}, \mathrm{z}$ এর সহগগুচ্ছ নিয়ে পাই ,


$\mathrm{D}=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}2 & 2 & -1 \\ 4 & 2 & -3 \\ 1 & 4 & 2\end{array}\right|$


$=2(4+12)-2(8+3)-1(16-2)$


$=2 \times 16-2 \times 11-1 \times 14$


$=32-22-14$


$=32-36=-4$


$D_{x}=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}5 & 2 & -1 \\ 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 4 & 2\end{array}\right|$


$=5(4+12)-2(2+18)-1(4-12)$


$=5 \times 16-2 \times 20+8$


$=80-40+8$


$=88-40=48$


$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{D}_y=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}2 & 5 & -1 \\ 4 & 1 & -3 \\ 1 & 6 & 2\end{array}\right| \\ & =2(2+18)-5(8+3)-1(24-1) \\ & =2 \times 20-5 \times 11-1 \times 23 \\ & =40-55-23 \\ & =40-78=-38 \\ & \mathrm{D}_z=\left|\begin{array}{rrr}2 & 2 & 5 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 4 & 6\end{array}\right| \\ & =2(12-4)-2(24-1)+5(16-2)\end{aligned}$


$\begin{aligned} & =2 \times 8-2 \times 23+5 \times 14 \\ & =16-46+70 \\ & =86-46=40 \\ & \therefore \quad x=\frac{D_x}{D}=\frac{48}{-4}=-12 \\ & y=\frac{D_y}{D}=\frac{-38}{-4}=\frac{19}{2} \\ & \quad z=\frac{D_z}{D}=\frac{40}{-4}=-10\end{aligned}$


সুতরাং , $(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y}, \mathrm{z})=\left(-12, \frac{19}{2},-10\right)[$ Ans. $]$

questions.question: একটি ত্রিভুজের দুইটি কৌণিক বিন্দুর স্থানাঙ্ক (–3, 4) এবং (5, 2)। এর ভরকেন্দ্রের স্থানাঙ্ক (1, 4)হলে , তৃতীয় কৌণিক বিন্দুর স্থানাংক বের কর
questions.answer:
ধরি, তৃতীয় বিন্দুর স্থানাংক (x , y)


$\therefore$ ভরকেন্দ্র $\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-3+5}{3}, \frac{\mathrm{y}+4+2}{3}\right)$


$=\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}+2}{3}, \frac{\mathrm{y}+6}{3}\right)$


$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{x}+2}{3}=1$


বা, $x+2=3$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=1$


এবং $\frac{y+6}{3}=4$


বা, $y+6=12$


$\therefore \mathrm{y}=6$


$\therefore$ তৃতীয় বিন্দুর স্থানাংক $(1,6)$ [Ans.]

questions.question: C হতে AB এর উপর অংকিত লম্বের পাদবিন্দুর স্থানাঙ্ক নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
AB রেখার সমীকরণ , $\frac{x-1}{1-0}=\frac{y-0}{0-4}$


বা, $ x-1=-\frac{y}{4} $


$ \text { বা, } 4 x-4=-y $


$ \therefore 4 x+y-4=0 .......... (i) $


(i) নং রেখার উপর অঙ্কিত লম্বের সমীকরণ ,


$\mathrm{x}-4 \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{k}=0 ..... (ii) $


(ii) নং রেখাটি $C(-2,-1)$ বিন্দুগামী,


বা, $-2-4 .(-1)+\mathrm{k}=0$


বা, $-2+4+\mathrm{k}=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{k}=-2$


$\mathrm{k}$ এর মান বসিয়ে , $\mathrm{x}-4 \mathrm{y}-2=0 ....... (iii) $


(i) ও (iii) নং সমীকরণ সমাধান করে,


$\frac{x}{-2-16}=\frac{y}{-4+8}=\frac{1}{-16-1}$


বা, $\frac{x}{-18}=\frac{y}{4}=\frac{1}{-17}$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\frac{-18}{-17}=\frac{18}{17}$ এবং $\mathrm{y}=\frac{4}{-17}=-\frac{4}{17}$


ইহাই নির্ণেয় স্থানাঙ্ক $\left(\frac{18}{17},-\frac{4}{17}\right)$

questions.question: দেখাও যে , (1, –1) বিন্দুগামী এবং AB রেখার সাথে 45° কোণ উৎপন্ন করে, এরূপ রেখা দুটি পরস্পর  লম্ব ।
questions.answer:
“খ" হতে পাই ,


$4 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-4=0$


বা, $4 \mathrm{x}-4=-\mathrm{y}$


$\therefore \mathrm{y}=-4 \mathrm{x}+4$


$\mathrm{AB}$ রেখার ঢাল $m_{1}=-4$


$(1,-1)$ বিন্দুগামী এবং m ঢালবিশিষ্ট রেখার সমীকরণ,


$\mathrm{y}+1=\mathrm{m}(\mathrm{x}-1)$


প্রশ্নমতে, $\tan \theta= \pm\left(\frac{\mathrm{m}-(-4)}{1+\mathrm{m} .(-4)}\right)$


বা, $\tan 45^{\circ}= \pm\left(\frac{m+4}{1-4 m}\right)$


$\therefore 1= \pm\left(\frac{\mathrm{m}+4}{1-4 \mathrm{~m}}\right)$


(+) নিয়ে পাই, $1=\frac{m+4}{1-4 m}$


বা, $1-4 m=m+4$


বা, $-4 \mathrm{~m}-\mathrm{m}=4-1$


বা, $-5 m=3$


$\therefore \mathrm{m}=\frac{-3}{5}$


m এর মান (i) সমীকরণে বসিয়ে পাই ,


$\mathrm{y}+1=-\frac{3}{5}(\mathrm{x}-1)$


বা, $5 y+5=-3 x+3$


$\therefore 3 \mathrm{x}+5 \mathrm{y}+2=0$


(-) নিয়ে পাই ,


$1=-\left(\frac{m+4}{1-4 m}\right)$


বা, $1-4 \mathrm{~m}=-\mathrm{m}-4$


বা, $-4 m+m=-4-1$


বা, $-3 m=-5$


$\therefore \mathrm{m}=\frac{5}{3}$


m এর মান (i) সমীকরণে বসিয়ে পাই ,


$\mathrm{y}+1=\frac{5}{3}(\mathrm{x}-1)$


বা, $3 y+3=5 x-5$


বা, $5 x-5=3 y+3$


$\therefore 5 \mathrm{x}-3 \mathrm{y}-8=0$


(ii) এর ঢাল নির্ণয়ঃ $3 x+5 y+2=0$


বা, $ 5 \mathrm{y}=-3 \mathrm{x}-2 $


$ \therefore \mathrm{y}=-\frac{3}{5} \mathrm{x}-\frac{2}{5} $


$ \therefore$ ঢাল, $ \mathrm{m}_{1}=-\frac{3}{5}$


(iii) এর ঢাল নির্ণয়ঃ $5 x-3 y-8=0$


বা, $-3 y=-5 x+8 $


$ \therefore y=\frac{5}{3} x-\frac{8}{3} $


$ \therefore$ ঢাল $ m_{2}=\frac{5}{3}$


$\therefore$ ঢালদ্বয়ের গুনফল $=\mathrm{m}_{1} \times \mathrm{m}_{2}$


$=-\frac{3}{5} \times \frac{5}{3}$


$=-1$


অতএব, রেখা দুইটি পরস্পর লম্ব ।

questions.question: (0, –3) ও (5, 0) বিন্দুদ্বয়ের সংযোজক সরলরেখার সমান্তরাল এবং (3,5) বিন্দুগামী সরলরেখার সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$(0,-3)$ ও $(5,0)$ বিন্দুদ্ধয়ের সংযোজক রেখার


সমীকরণ , $\frac{x-0}{0-5}=\frac{y+3}{-3-0}$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{x}}{-5}=\frac{\mathrm{y}+3}{-3}$


বা, $\frac{x}{5}=\frac{y+3}{3}$


বা, $3 x=5 y+15$


বা, $3 \mathrm{x}-5 \mathrm{y}-15=0$


$\therefore$ (i) এর সমান্তরাল রেখার সমীকরণ ,


$3 \mathrm{x}-5 \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{k}=0$


(ii) নং রেখা $(3,5)$ বিन्দুগামী হলে ,


$3.3-5.5+\mathrm{k}=0$


বা, $9-25+\mathrm{k}=0$


বা, $-16+\mathrm{k}=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{k}=16$


$\mathrm{k}$ এর মান (ii) নং সমীকরণে বসিয়ে পাই , $3 \mathrm{x}-5 \mathrm{y}+16=0$

questions.question: Q বিন্দু হতে AB রেখার লম্বদূরত্ব নির্ণয় কর
questions.answer:
ধরি $\mathrm{AB}$ রেখার সমীকরণ $\frac{x}{a}+\frac{y}{b}=1 .......... (i) $


দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{AP}=\mathrm{BP}$ এবং $\mathrm{P}(3,4) \mathrm{AB}$ এর মধ্যবিন্দু


অর্থাৎ $\frac{\mathrm{a}}{2}=3 \quad \therefore \mathrm{a}=6$


এবং $\frac{\mathrm{b}}{2}=4 \quad \therefore \mathrm{b}=8$


$\mathrm{A}(0,8)$ এবং $\mathrm{B}(6,0)$ বিন্দুগামী $\mathrm{AB}$ রেখার সমীকরণ,


$\frac{\mathrm{x}-0}{0-6}=\frac{\mathrm{y}-8}{8-0}$


বা, $\frac{x}{-6}=\frac{y-8}{8}$


বা, $\frac{x}{-3}=\frac{y-8}{4}$


বা, $4 \mathrm{x}=-3 \mathrm{y}+24$


$\therefore 4 \mathrm{x}+3 \mathrm{y}-24=0 .......... (ii) $


$Q(0,2)$ বিন্দু হতে $A B$ রেখার লম্বদূরত্ব $=\left|\frac{4.0+3.2-24}{\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}}\right|$


$=\left|\frac{-18}{\sqrt{16+9}}\right|$


$=\frac{18}{5}$ একক (Ans)

questions.question: Q বিন্দুগামী এবং P বিন্দু হতে 2 একক দূরবর্তী রেখাদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী কোণ নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
Q বিন্দুগামী এবং m ঢালবিশিষ্ট রেখার সমীকরণ,


$\mathrm{y}-2=\mathrm{m}(\mathrm{x}-0)$


$\therefore \mathrm{mx}-\mathrm{y}+2=0 .......... (i) $


$\mathrm{P}(3,4)$ বিন্দু হতে (i) নং রেখার দূরত্ব 2 একক ।


$\therefore\left|\frac{3 m-4+2}{\sqrt{m^{2}+(-1)^{2}}}\right|=2$


বা, $\left|\frac{3 m-2}{\sqrt{m^{2}+1}}\right|=2$


বা, $\frac{(3 m-2)^{2}}{m^{2}+1}=4$


বা, $(3 m-2)^{2}=4\left(m^{2}+1\right)$


বা, $9 m^{2}-12 m+4=4 m^{2}+4$


বা, $9 m^{2}-12 m+4-4 m^{2}-4=0$


বা, $5 m^{2}-12 m=0$


বা, $m(5 m-12)=0$


হয় , $\mathrm{m}=0$


অথবা, $5 \mathrm{~m}-12=0$


বা, $5 \mathrm{~m}=12$


$\therefore \mathrm{m}=\frac{12}{5}$


$\therefore \mathrm{m}_{1}=\frac{12}{5}$ এবং $\mathrm{m}_{2}=0$


$0-\frac{12}{5}$


মধ্যবর্তী কোণ $\theta$ হলে, $\tan \theta= \pm \frac{5}{1+0 \times \frac{12}{5}}$


$= \pm \frac{-\frac{12}{5}}{1+0}$


$= \pm \frac{12}{5}$


$\therefore \tan \theta=\frac{12}{5}$


বা, $\theta=\tan ^{-1} \frac{12}{5}$


﻿$\therefore \theta=67.4^{\circ}$


এবং $\tan \theta=\frac{-12}{5}$


বা, $ \theta=\tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{-12}{5}\right)$


$\therefore \quad \theta=112.6^{\circ}$


$\therefore$ রেখাদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী কোণ $67.4^{\circ}$ অথবা $112.6^{\circ}$ ।

questions.question: প্রমান করো যে, $\int \frac{d x}{\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}+c$, যেখানে $c$ একটি সমানুপাতিক ধ্রুবক ।
questions.answer:
ধরি , $x=a \sin \theta$ এবং $\theta=\sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}$


বা, $\mathrm{d} x=a \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}}=\int \frac{a \cos \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}{\sqrt{a^{2}-a^{2} \sin ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{a \cos \theta d \theta}{\sqrt{a^{2}\left(1-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)}}$


$=\int \frac{a \cos \theta d \theta}{\sqrt{a^{2} \cos ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{a \cos \theta d \theta}{a \cos \theta}$


$=\int \mathrm{d} \theta$


$=\theta+\mathrm{c}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{X}{a}+\mathrm{c}$


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\sqrt{a^{2}-x^{2}}}=\sin ^{-1} \frac{x}{a}+\mathrm{c}$

questions.question: মূল নিয়মে  $\frac{f(2 x)}{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)}$ এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin x$


বা, $f(2 x)=\sin 2 x$


বা, $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)=\cos 2 x$


আবার, $g(x)=\frac{f(2 x)}{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2 x\right)}$


$\Rightarrow g(x)=\frac{\sin 2 x}{\cos 2 x}$


$\therefore g(x)=\tan 2 x$


$\therefore g(x+h)=\tan 2(x+h)=\tan (2 x+2 h)$


অন্তরীকরনের মূল নিয়মানুসারে ,


$\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\{g(x)\}=\lim _{\mathrm{h} \rightarrow 0} \frac{g(x+h)-g(x)}{h} $


$ \therefore \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\tan 2 x)=\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\tan (2 x+2 h)-\tan 2 x}{h}$


$ =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h}\left\{\frac{\sin (2 x+2 h)}{\cos (2 x+2 h)}-\frac{\sin 2 x}{\cos 2 x}\right\}$


$ =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h} \frac{\sin \{(2 x+2 h)-2 x\}}{\cos 2 x \cos (2 x+2 h)} $


$ {[\because \sin (A-B)=\sin A \cos B-\cos A \sin B]} $


$ =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h} \frac{\sin (2 x+2 h-2 x)}{\cos 2 x \cos (2 x+2 h)} $


$ =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \quad \frac{1}{h} \frac{\sin 2 h}{\cos 2 x \cos (2 x+2 h)} $


$ =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin 2 h}{2 h} \times 2 \times \lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{\cos 2 x \cos (2 x+2 h)} $


$ =1 \times 2 \times \frac{1}{\cos 2 x \cdot \cos 2 x} $


$ =2 \times \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} 2 x}=2 \sec ^{2} 2 x $


$ \therefore \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\tan 2 x)=2 \sec ^{2} 2 x $ (Ans)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\frac{2 \ln \{g(x)\}}{\{g(x)\}^{2}}$ ফাংশনের সর্বোচ্চ মান $\frac{1}{e}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $ \quad g(x)=\sqrt{x}$


আবার, $ f(x)=\frac{2 \ln \{g(x)\}}{\{g(x)\}^{2}} $


$ =\frac{2 \ln \sqrt{x}}{(\sqrt{x})^{2}} $


$ =\frac{\ln (\sqrt{x})^{2}}{x}=\frac{\ln x}{x} $


$ \therefore f(x)=\frac{x \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\ln x)-\ln x \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(x)}{x^{2}} $


$=\frac{x^{\frac{1}{x}}-\ln x \cdot 1}{x^{2}}=\frac{1-\ln x}{x^{2}}$


$\therefore f^{\prime}(x)=\frac{x^{2} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(1-\ln x)-(1-\ln x) \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(x^{2}\right)}{x^{4}}$


$=\frac{x^{2}\left(0-\frac{1}{x}\right)-(1-\ln x) \cdot 2 x}{x^{4}}$


$=\frac{-x-2 x+2 x \ln x}{x^{4}}$


$=\frac{2 x \ln x-3 x}{x^{4}}=\frac{2 \ln x-3}{x^{3}}$


এখन, $f(x)=0$


বা, $\frac{1-\ln x}{x^{2}}=0$


বা, $1-\ln x=0$


বা, $\ln x=1$


বা, $\mathrm{e}^{\ln x}=\mathrm{e}^{1}$


$\therefore x=\mathrm{e} \quad$ [যেহেতু $\mathrm{e}^{\ln x}=x$ ]


$\therefore x=\mathrm{e}$ হলে, $f^{\prime}(\mathrm{e})=\frac{2 \ln \mathrm{e}-3}{\mathrm{e}^{3}}$


$=\frac{2-3}{\mathrm{e}^{3}}=\frac{-1}{\mathrm{e}^{3}}<0$


$\therefore x=\mathrm{e}$ এর জন্য ফাংশনটির মান সর্বোচ্চ ।


$\therefore$ সর্বোচ্চ মান $f(e)=\frac{\text { lne }}{\mathrm{e}}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{e}} \quad$ [Showed]

questions.question: $x^{1 / x}$ এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় কর
questions.answer:
মনে করি , $y=\begin{array}{r}1 \\ x^{x}\end{array}$


$\Rightarrow \ln \mathrm{y}=\ln \stackrel{1}{-}$


$\therefore \ln \mathrm{y}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}} \ln \mathrm{x}$


X-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরন করে পাই,


$\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}(\ln \mathrm{y})=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}} \ln \mathrm{x}\right)$


$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{y} \frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{1}{x} \frac{d}{d x}\{\ln (x)\}+\ln (x) \cdot \frac{d}{d x}\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)$


$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{\mathrm{y}} \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}=\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}} \cdot \frac{1}{\mathrm{x}}+\ln \mathrm{x}\left(-\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}}\right)$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}=\mathrm{y}\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}} \ln \mathrm{x}\right)$


$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}=x^{\frac{1}{x}}\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}} \ln \mathrm{x}\right)$


$\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}} x^{\frac{1}{x}}=x^{\frac{1}{x}} \cdot \frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}}(1-\ln \mathrm{x})$


$=x^{\frac{1}{x}} \cdot \frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}}(1-\ln \mathrm{x})$ (Ans)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, f(x, y) = 0 বক্ররেখার যে সকল বিন্দুতে স্পর্শকগুলো x অক্ষের উপর লম্ব, সে সকল বিন্দু (0, 0) এবং (–p, 0).
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{px}+\mathrm{y}^{2}$


এবং $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{px}+\mathrm{y}^{2}=0 .......... (i)$


X-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরন করে পাই,


$2 x+p+2 y \frac{d y}{d x}=0$


$\Rightarrow 2 y \frac{d y}{d x}=-2 x-p$


$\Rightarrow 2 y \frac{d y}{d x}=-(2 x+p)$


$\Rightarrow \frac{d y}{d x}=-\frac{(2 x+p)}{2 y}$


$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\mathrm{dy}}=-\frac{2 \mathrm{y}}{(2 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{p})}$


স্পর্শকের ক্ষেত্রে ,


$\frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}=\tan 90^{\circ}$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\mathrm{dy}}=\frac{1}{\tan 90^{\circ}}$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\mathrm{dy}}=\cot 90^{\circ}$


$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{dx}}{\mathrm{dy}}=0$


অর্থাৎ, $-\frac{2 y}{2 x+p}=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{y}=0$


$\mathrm{y}=0$ (i) নং সমীকরনে বসিয়ে পাই,


$\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{px}+0^{2}=0$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{px}=0$


$\Rightarrow \mathrm{x}(\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{p})=0$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=0$ অथবা, $\mathrm{x}=-\mathrm{p}$


$\therefore x$ অক্ষের উপর লম্ব স্পর্শকগুলো $(0,0)$


ও $(-p, 0)$ বিন্দু দিয়ে অতিক্রম করে।

questions.question: $\tan ^{-1} \mathrm{y}=\mathrm{ng}(\mathrm{x})$ হলে প্রমান কর যে, $\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}-2(n y-x) y_{1}=0$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $g(x)=\tan ^{-1} x$


এবং $\tan ^{-1} y=n g(x)$


$\Rightarrow \tan ^{-1} y=n \tan ^{-1} x$


$\Rightarrow y=\tan \left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right)$


$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(y)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left[\tan \left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right)\right]$


$\begin{aligned}& \Rightarrow y_{1}=\sec ^{2}\left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right) \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right) \\& {\left[\because \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\tan x)=\sec ^{2} x\right]} \\& \Rightarrow y_{1}=\sec ^{2}\left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right) \cdot \frac{\mathrm{n}}{1+x^{2}} \\& {\left[\because \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(\tan ^{-1} x\right)=\frac{1}{1+x^{2}}\right]} \\& \Rightarrow y_{1}\left(1+x^{2}\right)=n \sec ^{2}\left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right) \\& \Rightarrow y_{1}\left(1+x^{2}\right)=n\left[1+\tan ^{2}\left(n \tan ^{-1} x\right)\right] \\& \Rightarrow y_{1}\left(1+x^{2}\right)=n\left(1+y^{2}\right) \\& \Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left\{y_{1}\left(1+x^{2}\right)\right\}=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left[n\left(1+y^{2}\right)\right] \\& \Rightarrow y_{1} \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(1+x^{2}\right)+\left(1+x^{2}\right) \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(y_{1}\right)=n \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(1+y^{2}\right) \\& \Rightarrow y_{1}(0+2 x)+\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}=n\left(0+2 y y_{1}\right) \\& \Rightarrow y_{1} \cdot 2 x+\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}=n \cdot 2 y y_{1} \\& \Rightarrow\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}-2 n y y_{1}+2 x y_{1}=0 \\& \therefore\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}-2(n y-x) y_{1}=0 \text { [Proved] } \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos x}{1+\cos x}}\right\} $ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
প্রশ্নমতে,


$\begin{aligned} & \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos x}{1+\cos x}}\right\} \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\left.\frac{2 \sin ^2 \frac{x}{2}}{2 \cos ^2 \frac{x}{2}}\right\}}\left[\begin{array}{r}\geq 1-\cos 2 x=2 \sin ^2 x \\ 1+\cos 2 x=2 \cos ^2 x\end{array}\right]\right. \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \sqrt{\tan ^2 \frac{x}{2}}\right\} \\ & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left\{\ln \left(\tan \frac{x}{2}\right)\right\} \\ & =\frac{1}{\mathrm{~d}}\left(\tan \frac{x}{2}\right) \\ & \tan \frac{x}{2} \mathrm{~d} x\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned} & =\frac{1}{\tan \frac{x}{2}} \cdot \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}\left(\frac{x}{2}\right) \\ & =\cot \frac{x}{2} \cdot \sec ^2 \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{\cos _2^{-}}{\sin _2^{\frac{x}{2}}} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos ^2 \frac{x}{2}} \\ & =\frac{1}{2 \sin _2^{\frac{x}{2} \cos ^{\frac{x}{2}}}} \\ & =\frac{1}{\sin 2 \cdot \frac{x}{2}} \quad[\geq 2 \sin x \cos x=\sin 2 x] \\ & =\frac{1}{\sin x}=\operatorname{cosec} x \text { [Ans.] } \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $ \int \frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{1+3\left\{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}^{2}} $ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
f(x) = sinx


$\begin{aligned}& \therefore f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right) \\& =\cos \theta\end{aligned}$


$\therefore \int \frac{d \theta}{1+3\left\{f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)\right\}^{2}}$


$=\int \frac{d \theta}{1+3(\cos \theta)^{2}}$


$=\int \frac{d \theta}{1+3 \cos ^{2} \theta}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{d \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}{\frac{1+3 \cos ^{2} \theta}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{1}{\cos ^{2} \theta} d \theta}{\frac{1}{\cos ^{2} \theta}+\frac{3 \cos ^{2}}{\cos ^{2} \theta}}$


$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \theta d \theta}{\sec ^{2} \theta+3}$


$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \theta d \theta}{1+\tan ^{2} \theta+3}$ [যেহেতু, $\sec ^{2} \theta=1+\tan ^{2} \theta$ ]


ধরি


$\quad \tan \theta=z $


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(\tan \theta)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(z) $


বা, $\sec ^2 \theta=\frac{\mathrm{dz}}{\mathrm{d}} $


$ \therefore \mathrm{d} z=\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$


$\begin{aligned} & =\int \frac{\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}{\tan ^2 \theta+4} \\ & \therefore \int \frac{\sec ^2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta}{\tan ^2 \theta+4}=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^2+4} \\ & =\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^2+2^2} \\ & =\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{2^2+z^2} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{z}{2}\right)+\mathrm{c} \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan \theta}{2}\right)+\mathrm{c} \text { [Ans.] }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2}$ $f(x) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{7}{3}$
questions.answer:
এখানে, $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)$


$=\cos X$


$\therefore\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2} f(x) \mathrm{d} x$


$=(1+\cos x)^{2} \sin x d x$


ধরি, $\cos x=z$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\cos x)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} x}(\mathrm{z})$


বা, $-\sin x=\frac{\mathrm{dz}}{\mathrm{dx}}$


বা, $-\sin x \mathrm{~d} x=\mathrm{d} z$


$\therefore \sin x \mathrm{~d} x=-\mathrm{d} z$


$=\int_{1}^{0}(1+z)^{2}(-\mathrm{d} z)$


$=-\int_{1}^{0}(1+z)^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1}(1+z)^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1}\left(1+2 z+z^{2}\right) \mathrm{d} z$


$=\int_{0}^{1} 1 \cdot \mathrm{d} z+\int_{0}^{1} 2 z \mathrm{~d} z+\int_{0}^{1} z^{2} \mathrm{~d} z$


$=[z]_{0}^{1}+2\left[\frac{z^{2}}{2}\right] 1+\left[\frac{z^{3}}{3}\right] \begin{aligned} & 1 \\ & 0\end{aligned}$


$=(1-0)+2 \times\left(\frac{1^{2}}{2}-\frac{0^{2}}{2}\right)+\left(\frac{1^{3}}{3}-\frac{0^{3}}{3}\right)$


$=1+2 \times \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{3}$


$=1+1+\frac{1}{3}$


$=\frac{3+3+1}{3}=\frac{7}{3}$


$\therefore\left\{1+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)\right\}^{2} f(x) \mathrm{d} x=\frac{7}{3} \quad$ [Showed]

questions.question: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{x}$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos 2 \cdot \frac{x}{2}}{x}$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \sin ^{2} \cdot \frac{x}{2}}{x} \quad\left[1-\cos 2 x=2 \sin ^{2} x\right]$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{4 \cdot\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}} \cdot x$


$=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}} \cdot x$


$=\frac{1}{2} \cdot \frac{x}{2} \rightarrow \frac{\lim }{}\left(\frac{\sin \frac{x}{2}}{\frac{x}{2}}\right)^{2} \times \lim _{x \rightarrow 0} x$


$=\frac{1}{2} \cdot 1 \cdot 0=0$ (Ans)

questions.question: $\int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{\mathrm{p}(x)}}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$P(x)=4x+3$


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{\mathrm{P}(x)}}=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{4 x+3}}$


ধরি,


$4 x+3=Z^2 \ldots (i)$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z}(4 x+3)=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} z}\left(z^{2}\right)$


বা, $4 \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} z}=2 z$


বা, $4 \mathrm{~d} x=2 z \mathrm{~d} z$


বা, $2 \mathrm{~d} x=z \mathrm{~d} z$


$\therefore \mathrm{d} x=\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2} \quad \ldots \ldots$... (ii)


এখন, $4 x+3=z^{2}$


বা, $4 x=z^{2}-3$


বা, $2 x=\frac{z^{2}-3}{2}$


বা, $2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-3}{2}+1$


বা, $2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-3+2}{2}$


$\therefore 2 x+1=\frac{z^{2}-1}{2} \ldots \ldots \ldots (iii) $


$\therefore \int \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{(2 x+1) \sqrt{4 x+3}}=\int \frac{\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2}}{\frac{z^{2}-1}{2} \cdot \sqrt{z^{2}}}$


$=\int \frac{\frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2}}{\frac{\left(z^{2}-1\right) z}{2}}$


$=\int \frac{z \mathrm{~d} z}{2} \square \frac{2}{z\left(z^{2}-1\right)}$


$=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^{2}-1}$


$=\int \frac{\mathrm{d} z}{z^{2}-1^{2}}$


$=\frac{1}{2^{\prime} 1} \ln \left|\frac{z-1}{z+1}\right|+\mathrm{c}$


$=\frac{1}{2} \ln \left|\frac{\sqrt{4 x+3}-1}{\sqrt{4 x+3}+1}\right|+c$ [Ans.]

questions.question: ক্যালকুলাসের সাহায্যে 4{Q(x)}2 + 9 {Q(y)}2 = 36 বক্ররেখাটির দ্বারা আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{Q}(x)=x$


এখানে, $\quad 4\{\mathrm{Q}(x)\}^{2}+9\{\mathrm{Q}(y)\}^{2}=36$


বা, $4 x^{2}+9 y^{2}=36 \ldots (1)$


বা, $\frac{4 x^{2}}{36}+\frac{9 y^{2}}{36}=\frac{36}{36}$


বা, $\frac{x^{2}}{9}+\frac{y^{2}}{4}=1$


বা, $\frac{y^{2}}{4}=1-\frac{x^{2}}{9}$


বা, $\frac{y^{2}}{4}=\frac{9-x^{2}}{9} $


বা, $ y^{2}=\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^{2}\right) $


বা, $ y= \pm \sqrt{\frac{4}{9}\left(9-x^{2}\right)} $


বা, $ y= \pm \frac{2}{3} \sqrt{\left(9-x^{2}\right)} $


$ \therefore y=\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-x^{2}} $


$ \therefore$ এক-চতুর্থাংশের ক্ষেত্রফল $=\int_{0}^{3} y \mathrm{~d} x $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{9-x^{2}} \mathrm{~d} x $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-(3 \sin \theta)^{2}} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9-9 \sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{9\left(1-\sin ^{2} \theta\right)} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


ধরি, $ x=3 \sin \theta $


বা, $ \frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} \theta}=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d} \theta}(3 \sin \theta) $


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{d} x}{\mathrm{~d} \theta}=3 \cos \theta $


$ \therefore \mathrm{d} x=3 \cos \mathrm{d} \theta $



$ =\frac{2}{3} \cdot 3 \sqrt{1-\sin ^{2} \theta} \cdot 3 \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =2 \cdot 3 \sqrt{\cos ^{2} \theta} \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cos \theta \cdot \cos \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta $


$ =6 \cdot \frac{1}{2} 2 \cos ^{2} \theta d \theta $


$ =3(1+\cos 2 \theta) d \theta $


$ =3 \mathrm{~d} \theta+3 \cos 2 \theta d \theta $


$ =3[\theta]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}+3\left[\frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} $


$ =3\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-0\right)+\frac{3}{2}\left(\sin 2 \cdot \frac{\pi}{2}-\sin 2.0\right) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+\frac{3}{2}(\sin \pi-\sin 0) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+\frac{3}{2}(0-0) $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2}+0 $


$ =\frac{3 \pi}{2} $


মোট আবদ্ধ ক্ষেত্রের ক্ষেত্রফল $=4 \times \mathrm{OAB}$ বর্গ একক


$=4 \times \frac{3}{2} \pi$ বর্গ একক


$=6 \pi$ বর্গ একক (Ans.)
